guidance.bestFor: An always open list inside a narrow Card, with a disabled Calculator row and shortcut hints on the Settings rows only
agentNotes: `disabled` on the Calculator `CommandItem` drops it from arrow key navigation and ignores clicks on it

whenNotToUse.when: The same Suggestions and Settings groups opened in a modal from a button

guidance.bestFor: The smallest modal palette, a single Settings group of 3 rows with a shortcut hint on each
agentNotes: The palette opens only from the `Button` that calls `setOpen`; no global key listener exists, so add one for a shortcut such as ⌘K

whenNotToUse.when: A menu shown in place on the page that needs no button to open it

guidance.bestFor: A modal with 2 groups, Suggestions as plain rows and Settings rows with shortcut hints, split by a separator

whenNotToUse.when: The same rows kept open in a card on the page with no modal

guidance.bestFor: A dense palette of 5 groups and 23 rows, from navigation and file actions to view, account and tools

whenNotToUse.when: A short palette where one group of a few rows is enough

guidance.bestFor: A file finder whose rows show name, muted path and a type Badge, opened from a search style trigger with a Kbd hint
agentNotes: Replace `files` with your own list; each row is keyed by `file.path`, so paths must stay unique
The ⌘K `Kbd` on the trigger is only a label; add a keydown listener that calls `setOpen` to make it work
Each `CommandItem` filters on its whole text, so a query also matches `file.path` and the `file.type` badge

whenNotToUse.when: A search over people with avatars, emails and role badges

guidance.bestFor: A people search with avatar, name over email, and a role Badge tinted per Admin, Editor or Viewer
agentNotes: Replace `users`; every `avatar` URL points at images.unsplash.com, so serve your own images
Roles other than Admin and Editor fall through to `success-light`; extend the `variant` ternary when you add roles
`CommandDialog` keeps its default `title` Command Palette for screen readers; pass one that names the user search

whenNotToUse.when: A finder over project files with paths and type badges

guidance.bestFor: Task verbs grouped as Create, Navigate and System, from New Project and Invite Member to dark mode and sign out
agentNotes: No listener binds the `CommandShortcut` hints such as ⌘N and ⌘⇧D; register each key yourself
`CommandShortcut` lists ⌘N and ⌘Q, which browsers keep for a new window and quit; pick other keys before you bind them

whenNotToUse.when: A jump list of starred and recently visited pages rather than tasks

name: c-command-8
title: Command with recent and favorites sections
label: Recent & Favorites
description: Command with recent and favorites sections

guidance.bestFor: A jump list of starred favorites, recent pages stamped 2m to 2h ago and help links, opened as Search Everything
agentNotes: The Recent rows hard code 2m ago to 2h ago in a `data-slot` command-shortcut div; feed them from your own visit history
A wrapper with `data-slot` set to command-shortcut hides the trailing check of `CommandItem`, which keeps the time at the right edge

whenNotToUse.when: A palette of create, navigate and system tasks with shortcut hints
